parameters.description:
`msg-to-zulip` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Zulip destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Zulip destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Zulip destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Zulip destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Zulip organization
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Zulip destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

base.description: This enrollment's Zulip base URL. Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.

basic.description: This enrollment's ZULIP_BASIC value (same format as ZULIP_BASIC). Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.
